back: s = α·x + (1 − α)·s. Start with s = first value. O(1) time and memory.
α = 1 − exp(−dt/τ). A longer gap gives a larger α.
Refill: tokens = min(capacity, tokens + elapsed·rate). If tokens >= cost: spend and allow; else reject.

front: What does a token bucket allow that a strict limiter does not?
back: Short bursts up to the capacity, with a steady average rate.
Up to twice the limit can pass around a window boundary.
